What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid]]: left, the image of [[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Errata)]] (holotable commit 35aa2a6); right, the image of [[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit a41bae9).
